title: Understanding Linear Models
text: A linear model is linear in terms of the parameters (coefficients) that we are estimating. This means that the model should be a linear combination of the parameters.

title: Identifying Linear Models
text: Check if the model can be expressed as a linear combination of the parameters. For example, $$y=\theta_0+\theta_1 {x_1}^2$$ is linear in theta because it is a linear combination of $$\theta_0$$ and $$\theta_1$$.

title: Analyzing the Given Model
text: Is the model $$y=\theta_0+\theta_1 {x_1}^2$$ linear with respect to theta?
